component.name: Btrfs Assistant Harbor
component.summary: Native Btrfs/Snapper snapshots and verified remote backup

description.p: Btrfs Assistant Harbor extends the upstream Btrfs Assistant desktop with Snapper-aware off-device Btrfs backups, a shared content-addressed Rust repository, verification, safe retention and staged recovery.
Supports Linux x86-64; network-filesystem destructive CAS pruning, macOS/APFS and encrypted multi-root bare-metal rescue are not supported.
